answer: Zero-knowledge nullifier binding resists Sybil attacks by requiring each agent key to submit a SNARK over a signed e-passport, outputting a deterministic nullifier that caps accounts per person. Attackers incur the scarce cost of procuring distinct human IDs per identity rather than cloning free keys. One limitation is that this ivory assumption of exclusive control fails across an unregulated tundra where brokers rent passports without leaving a whisper of on-chain proof.
